addon:addon.name: X-Sense Binding
addon:addon.description: Integrates X-Sense smoke, carbon monoxide, heat and water leak detectors, thermo-hygrometers and security accessories (door/window and motion sensors, keypads, alarm listeners, driveway, mailbox and strobe alarms) connected through an X-Sense base station (e.g. SBS50) using the X-Sense cloud, including arming and disarming the base station.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Default Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Default interval in seconds for polling the device inventory from the X-Sense cloud. Used by all accounts that do not configure an own interval.
